curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: realise the importance of writing correct and meaningful sentences to express meaning.

mission.title: Write a Message That Makes Sense

interactions.prompt: Which group of words gives a complete message?
interactions.feedback: Yes! It tells who or what and what happens.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the words that make sense together.

interactions.prompt: Put the words in a meaningful order.
interactions.feedback: Correct! I use a tablet expresses a clear idea.
interactions.retryHint: Begin with I, then add the action use.

interactions.prompt: Match each sentence beginning to the ending that makes sense.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a beginning, then its sensible ending.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! Each sentence now shares a meaningful idea.
interactions.retryHint: Think about what each device part can do.

interactions.prompt: Choose the two correct, meaningful sentences.
interactions.feedback: Right! Both sentences are correctly ordered and make sense.
interactions.retryHint: A sentence should sound natural when read aloud.

interactions.prompt: Choose the word that makes the message meaningful: I ___ my tablet to learn.
interactions.feedback: Great choice! I use my tablet to learn is meaningful.
interactions.retryHint: Which action can you do with a tablet?

interactions.prompt: Why should a sentence be correct and meaningful?
choices: So the reader understands my idea
So it has the most words
So every word begins with a capital
interactions.answer: So the reader understands my idea
interactions.feedback: Wonderful! Clear sentences carry your meaning to the reader.
interactions.retryHint: Writing works when another person understands it.
